# Pre-Implementation Readiness Checklist: List tmux Sessions

**Purpose**: Assess completeness, clarity, consistency, and measurability of the written requirements before task generation
**Created**: 2026-10-23
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)
**Focus**: CLI/TUI contracts, tmux data and failure semantics, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and quality policy
**Depth**: Standard
**Audience and Timing**: Reviewer, before implementation task generation

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are all five session fields and their meanings defined for both interfaces, including detached sessions and the current window rather than a pane or viewport? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001-FR-004, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK002 Are default entry points, explicit interface choices, terminal preconditions, and invalid-input outcomes fully specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-016-FR-017, CLI Contract §Commands]
- [x] CHK003 Are full-name and hidden-field inspection, keyboard help, refresh, cancellation, and exit requirements defined across all TUI screens? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005-FR-008, Spec §FR-013-FR-014, TUI Contract §Screens and keys]
- [x] CHK004 Are mandatory formatting and linting policies explicitly required for both local work and CI, with unambiguous failure criteria rather than advisory status? [Completeness, Plan §Technical Context, Constitution §Development Workflow and Quality Gates]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK005 Is the invoking client's active session distinguished unambiguously from the invoking pane's context, attachment count, and focused row, including shared or grouped windows? [Clarity, Ambiguity, Spec §FR-003, Data Model §Invoking context]
- [x] CHK006 Are uptime units, display precision, capture time, local ticking, and treatment of future creation timestamps precisely documented? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, Data Model §Uptime]
- [x] CHK007 Are column budgets or equivalent decision rules specific enough to determine when each optional field disappears or returns, without relying on terms such as "ordinary values"? [Clarity, Ambiguity, Spec §FR-005, TUI Contract §Layout and complete information]
- [x] CHK008 Are structured and plain output field names, types, units, ordering, escaping, and unavailable-value representations explicitly defined? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009, Spec §FR-015, CLI Contract §Data and ordering]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK009 Are full-name preservation requirements consistent with text escaping, TUI truncation, and complete detail inspection across the specification and contracts? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002, Spec §FR-005, Spec §FR-009, CLI Contract §Human table, TUI Contract §Layout and complete information]
- [x] CHK010 Is the requirement for boolean active status reconciled explicitly with the contract's null value when active context is unavailable? [Consistency, Conflict, Spec §FR-003, Spec §FR-012, Spec §FR-015, CLI Contract §JSON]
- [x] CHK011 Are manual refresh and snapshot-freshness requirements consistent with locally changing uptime and the exclusion of continuous background updates? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008, Spec §Assumptions, Data Model §Uptime, TUI Contract §Loading, refresh, and errors]
- [x] CHK012 Are empty-result, partial-result, fatal-error, cancellation, and normal TUI-exit meanings consistent across stream/status requirements and both interface contracts? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010-FR-012, CLI Contract §Empty, partial and failed results, TUI Contract §Screens and keys]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK013 Do the latency criteria distinguish successful session visibility from bounded error reporting so that repeated fast failures cannot satisfy the primary user outcome? [Measurability, Ambiguity, Spec §SC-001, Spec §SC-006]
- [x] CHK014 Are the timing start/end points, representative environment, session workload, number of trials, and required passing proportion defined for initial visibility, refresh, and resize? [Measurability, Gap, Spec §SC-001, Spec §SC-003, Spec §SC-006, Plan §Technical Context]
- [x] CHK015 Is cross-interface equality defined with explicit allowances for elapsed-time precision and changing snapshots rather than an impossible simultaneous-value comparison? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002, Data Model §Snapshot and issues, Data Model §Uptime]
- [x] CHK016 Are participant expectations, task-completion conditions, timing boundaries, and the permitted use of built-in help specified for the five-person usability criterion? [Measurability, Gap, Spec §SC-004]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK017 Are primary and alternate requirements defined for attached and detached sessions, invocation outside tmux, explicit CLI use, and redirected streams? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 1, Spec §User Story 3, Spec §FR-017]
- [x] CHK018 Are exception requirements distinct for missing tmux, unsupported versions, absent servers, access denial, malformed data, and unavailable individual fields? [Coverage, Spec §FR-011-FR-012, CLI Contract §Empty, partial and failed results, Plan §Technical Context]
- [x] CHK019 Are recovery requirements specified for failed initial acquisition, failed refresh with retained data, partial refresh, and a later successful refresh? [Coverage, Spec §FR-012, Data Model §TUI state and transitions, TUI Contract §Loading, refresh, and errors]
- [x] CHK020 Are the requirements for help, repeated refresh requests, resizing, and cancellation during an outstanding request explicitly defined? [Coverage, Spec §FR-006, Spec §FR-008, Spec §FR-013-FR-014, TUI Contract §Loading, refresh, and errors]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK021 Are boundary requirements defined at, immediately below, and above the minimum terminal dimensions and the all-fields width, including recovery from a zero-cell viewport? [Coverage, Spec §FR-005-FR-007, TUI Contract §Layout and complete information]
- [x] CHK022 Are complete-name requirements defined for long names, wide or combining characters, embedded whitespace, control characters, and invalid text without silent data loss? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, CLI Contract §Human table, CLI Contract §JSON, Data Model §Session identity and fields]
- [x] CHK023 Are identity, focus, and detail-view requirements defined for rename, disappearance during acquisition, removal of the focused session, and recreation with the same name? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-008, Spec §Key Entities, Data Model §TUI state and transitions]
- [x] CHK024 Are diagnostic, status, and output-completeness requirements fully specified for interrupted output and early closed pipes? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-010, CLI Contract §Empty, partial and failed results]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK025 Are keyboard-only access and non-color-only distinctions specified for focus, active status, unavailable fields, stale data, and minimum-size warnings? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, Spec §FR-006-FR-007, Spec §FR-012-FR-013, TUI Contract §Layout and complete information]
- [x] CHK026 Are terminal-restoration and bounded-cancellation requirements documented for normal exit, interruption, partial setup failure, handled errors, and restoration failure itself? [Completeness, Gap, Spec §FR-014, TUI Contract §Lifecycle and capabilities]
- [x] CHK027 Are read-only scope, control-character safety, session-data retention, and the exclusion of unintended external communication explicitly stated? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014, Spec §Scope and Configuration Impact, CLI Contract §Help, environment and color]
- [x] CHK028 Are maximum acquisition duration, cancellation responsiveness, and output/resource limits quantified with explicit failure outcomes rather than merely described as bounded? [Measurability, Gap, Spec §SC-001, Spec §SC-006, Plan §Technical Context, Data Model §Process ownership]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK029 Are the selected platform and minimum tmux-version assumptions explicit, justified, and connected to requirements for unsupported environments? [Completeness, Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, Plan §Technical Context, CLI Contract §Empty, partial and failed results]
- [x] CHK030 Is the default-server-context assumption precise for invocation inside and outside tmux, including inherited-context absence or inconsistency, without silently broadening multi-server scope? [Clarity, Assumption, Spec §FR-001, Spec §Scope and Configuration Impact, Data Model §Invoking context]
- [x] CHK031 Are the dependencies on built-in help, standard color/environment conventions, and the project constitution distinguished from optional external guidance? [Consistency, Assumption, Spec §FR-013, Spec §FR-015-FR-016, Spec §Assumptions, Plan §Constitution Check]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [x] CHK032 Are the identities of the active feature and branch consistent across specification metadata and planning artifacts? [Consistency, Conflict, Spec §Feature Branch, Plan §Branch]
- [x] CHK033 Is the scope of "all five fields visible" reconciled with permitted numeric compaction or truncation at the 120-column baseline, with explicit supported value ranges if necessary? [Clarity, Conflict, Spec §FR-005, TUI Contract §Layout and complete information]
- [x] CHK034 Are product requirements distinguishable from provisional design assumptions and unverified integration claims, with ownership of unresolved decisions identified before task generation? [Traceability, Gap, Plan §Phase 0: Research Decisions, Plan §Post-design gate review]
